screens.title: Wallet
screens.text: The wallet tab shows balances and actions. The added Sell button opens the sell page; Send opens the send flow.
screens.source: `run-sale.mjs --handbook-shots` on the `before` and `sale` builds of `e2e/wallet-ui/build.sh` at module commit e40665b, on 2026-11-13; nothing was sent.

screens.title: Send review
screens.text: The review shows a 1 USDT send on Ethereum (Sepolia), its recipient, network fee and total. Previously the fee was shown in USDT and included in the total; the updated review shows the fee in ETH and excludes it from the USDT total. Confirm sends the transaction.
screens.source: `run-sale.mjs --handbook-shots` on the `before` and `sale` builds at module commit e40665b, on 2026-11-13, with recipient 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; the flow stops at the review and nothing was sent.

screens.title: Sell widget
screens.text: The Sell page opens the DFX widget with 1 USDT selected. On the bank step, the user can add or select an IBAN; Done returns to the wallet.
screens.source: `run-sale.mjs --send --confirm --screenshots` during the real sale of 2026-11-13 at module commit 320d669 (Sepolia transaction 0x4a2f…e822), on the bank step before an IBAN was entered.

screens.title: Send success
screens.text: This screen comes from the starter wallet and appears after sending in the sale flow, showing a shortened transaction hash.
screens.source: `run-sale.mjs --send --confirm --screenshots` during the same real sale, after the one tap on Confirm.

gaps.reason: The loading state is transient and is replaced by the widget.
A failed sell() call or missing sell URL produces an error; these states cannot be induced in the real run without falsification.
These steps expose the payout IBAN alongside the deposit address.
The fee display change also applies to other non-native Ethereum tokens; only USDT is captured.
